title: Grandia II
text:
Grandia II is the sequel to Grandia as a spiritual success. It was originally released on the Dreamcast and later ported to the PlayStation 2 and Windows. On it's 15th anniversary, it was enhanced and released for Windows as Grandia II Anniversary Edition. As part of the Grandia HD Collection, this game was further updated and renamed Grandia II HD Remaster. It was also released on the Nintendo Switch as part of Grandia HD Collection.

 Story 
The story follows Ryudo, guarding Elena when she unknowingly possess Millenia from another world that inhabits her body. They go through the adventure to resolve Elena's dilemma when Elena's group failed the ceremony, thus setting off around the world in cleansing Elena of her darkness while unknowingly allow Millennia to take over during the course of the story. The gameplay is almost similar with a few upgrades with the magic and moves, including allowing AI's to do the work for you, should you have trouble learning how this game works.
